ssb_audio_api_status: No verified StatsBank table containing the audiobook-specific measure located. Generic lydmedier/audio-media API tables are a broader construct and must not substitute for audiobooks.
automatic_ingestion_rule: Monitor source releases and compare document hashes. Annual summaries/tables can be parsed only when the measure, age base, period and explicit published percentages are recognized. Unknown schema or new versions require review before adding a year. Do not interpolate missing years, invent current-year data or turn source change into a validated observation.
